name: fynn-mods
description: Fynn's daily-driver Claude Code mods: an animated mascot, usage-limit bars, a pre-send sidekick, quick replies, a music bar for Spotify (Windows) and a cost ledger.

plugins.name: clawd-buddy
plugins.description: Animated pixel mascot Clawd above the prompt: reacts to Claude's work, waiting times, idle time, time of day, the mouse and a mood that builds up over the session.

plugins.name: limit-bars
plugins.description: Bars or rings for the 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt (weekly pace when there is no 5-hour limit), a ring showing how long the prompt cache stays warm, and an optional ring for drive usage by file type. Cache guard: asks before an expensive cold send; /cache, /handoff, /keepwarm, /disk, /bars. Every part of the display can be hidden.

plugins.name: sidekick
plugins.description: Checks your message before it is sent, by rules and, where worthwhile, briefly with Haiku 5.5: a hint line under your message or a question (new chat with handoff, a skill, a clearer version that is only sent if you choose it, or "wrong chat?" when the message belongs to another project). It never rewrites or sends anything without asking. Names due maintenance (/skill-doctor, prompt-audit, consolidate-memory, /init) with a button that puts the command into the prompt box for you to send and a ? that explains why it is due. Three levels (off, cache, guide) with a colored label in the prompt footer. /savings shows cost and measurable savings at a glance, /savings detail compares the models over time. Optional, off by default (/sidekick notes on): while Claude works, a "good to know" note above the prompt when you likely missed something with consequences (one question to your main model over the conversation, every 6 steps). /sidekick help shows all commands and settings as a table.

plugins.name: quick-replies
plugins.description: Claude Code's own next-message suggestion as a button above Clawd; click it, type 1 in the empty prompt, or send just 1 to send it. With /replies more on, a fork of the session fills up to four places in total. /replies help shows all commands and settings as a table.

plugins.name: tune-strip
plugins.description: Windows only. Music bar for Spotify above the prompt: album cover, title, artist, position and clickable controls (restart/previous, play/pause, next). Reads the Windows media controls, no login, no network. /tune help shows all commands and settings as a table.

plugins.name: cost-ledger
plugins.description: Cost ledger across all chats: after every answer it records the chat cost (as /cost), tokens per model and model calls made by other mods. /ledger shows totals for today, 7 and 30 days and all time (chats incl. their mod calls), the last 14 days, projects and the most expensive chats; /ledger here shows what this project and this chat cost, with the chat share as a ring; /ledger limits shows the API value in the current 5-hour and weekly window and in your subscription month, plus an estimate of the usage outside the ledger (claude.ai, phone); /ledger sync <folder> merges your devices through a shared folder (amounts and the project folder name only: no paths or chat titles); /ledger help lists all commands, the current state and your settings. Observer only, no model calls.
